prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity flat screenshot of a real desktop software collaboration app named Console Connect, landscape 1600 by 1000 approximately. Render only the application interface, edge to edge, no laptop, no perspective, no poster. Precise mature developer tool design for long coding sessions: graphite charcoal surfaces, warm ivory readable type, restrained pale chartreuse primary actions, hairline separators, subtly rounded 5px controls, generous but productive spacing. Clear sans-serif UI, monospace only for code and branch names. Authored thin line icons. No gradients, no neon glows, no oversized marketing headline. This is a proposed design using illustrative task data, not a live screenshot.
Product truth: people work locally with their own AI subscriptions; assignments require recipient approval; outputs are drafts until submitted; review acceptance is separate from GitHub merge; terminal sharing is optional and view-only. Brand header Console Connect. Workspace example "Acme / web-app". People Alex, Sam, Jordan. Tools Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity. Realistic task examples "Build login flow", "Review session expiry", "Document auth decisions". Selected task "Build login flow", assigned to "Sam", status "Ready to start", tool "Codex CLI". Main action "Start local session". Repository branch "task/login-flow". A terminal panel showing a prompt and no AI already running on an unapproved task. Small sharing control "Private · Share view". Discussion from Alex: "Keep the existing session timeout." and Sam: "I will include the verification results." Review package fields summary, changes, verification, open questions, state "Draft · only you". Task navigation, team member list, connection label "Connected · Computer host". All text must be coherent and legible. Composition A: review desk. Narrow 230px left sidebar with workspace switcher and task list, broad 970px central work area with selected task overview at top and a large terminal area below, 340px right discussion column. Bottom right of center a compact draft package bar. Keep the terminal the main work surface, discussions always visible, selected task prominent. Top toolbar quiet and concise.
